_about: Hand-checkable ground truth for tests/fixtures/pikeview.test.js. Names/ages were produced by the parser, then cross-checked against an independent extractor (poppler pdftotext) and, for Qsw/Kda/Qc, against the list Mason provided. Edit this file (not the test) when you verify or correct a unit.
source: OF-01-03 Geologic Map of the Pikeview Quadrangle, El Paso County, Colorado (Colorado Geological Survey, 2001). Public document.
